    Prepare a Seurat Object for ORPHEUS Analysis

    prepare_seurat_for_orpheus.Rd

    This function performs global, one-time pre-processing on a Seurat object. It filters genes based on expression across all cells and then normalizes the data using edgeR's TMM method, also across all cells. This ensures all cells are on a common, comparable scale before being split into groups for analysis. The normalized counts are stored in a new assay.

    prepare_seurat_for_orpheus(
  seurat_obj,
  assay = "RNA",
  new_assay_name = "ORPHEUS_norm",
  min_prop = 0.01,
  min_count = 1,
  verbose = TRUE
)

    Arguments

    seurat_obj

    A Seurat object with raw counts in the specified assay.

    assay

    The assay containing raw counts (default is "RNA").

    new_assay_name

    The name for the new assay that will store the normalized counts (default is "ORPHEUS_norm").

    min_prop

    The minimum proportion of cells expressing a gene to retain it, passed to sparse_filter_by_expr() (default is 0.01).

    min_count

    The minimum count threshold for a gene to be considered expressed in a cell (default is 1).

    verbose

    Logical indicating whether to print progress messages (default is TRUE).

    Value

    A Seurat object with a new assay containing globally filtered and normalized counts.
